sources.title: Supertron3-0.8B API & Inference Endpoint | FriendliAI
sources.snippet: Model Description Supertron3-0.8B is a compact Vision-Language Model (VLM) purpose-built for GUI Agents and agentic tool calling at the edge. It operates across diverse digital environments — web, desktop, and CLI — by interpreting visual interfaces, reasoning over complex content, and emitting precise actions (pyautogui-style computer use) or valid JSON function calls.
